# Analysis lenses

Reusable ways of looking at the problem, and the criteria options will be judged against.

## Lenses

- **Cost**: cost to serve per order and the cost of each change.
- **Risk**: operational and delivery risk, especially during peak.
- **Customer experience**: delivery promise, accuracy and visibility for customers.
- **Operating model**: roles, processes and governance in the DCs.

## Evaluation criteria

- **Time to value**: benefit visible within one quarter.
- **Ease of adoption**: can be run by the current DC teams.
